svg.title: The Captain Who Charted the Moon
svg.desc: A book photograph of two swashbucklers: convincing counterweighted poses, layered costume, foreshortened hands, broad hat silhouettes, curved cloth folds and dense directional crosshatching. The new scene studies these principles without tracing either figure. Exactly 7.000 s, continuous loop: 0–0.84 s settle and glance; 0.84–1.68 s telescope arm dips 5° in anticipation; 1.68–3.78 s lift and observe with a −5° shoulder pose; 3.78–5.04 s hold while head and chart follow subtly; 5.04–7.00 s return to the initial pose. The specific shoulder/arm/telescope group moves, with independently delayed head and chart-hand motion. All SMIL clocks are seven seconds.
svg.text: THE CAPTAIN WHO CHARTED THE MOON
